paragraphs: (Tzadok the Kohen, II Samuel 15:27.) See the entry R' Elazar son of R' Tzadok.[^1]

notes.text: The named Miqra according to the Masorah text of II Samuel 15:27 has Tzadok the priest. It does not support expanding the abbreviated rabbinic titles in the heading or cross-reference. Those remain R', the three numbered entries remain separate, and the biblical parenthesis is not used to identify them with the priest or to bind the cross-reference.
